title: Ubizo oluvela kwiNtlambo eNgcwele
intro: Ngaphaya kwembali kukho ibali lomphefumlo omi phakathi komlawuli onamandla kunye nabantu bonke abakhotyokisiweyo. Lo mntu wabizwa ukuba akhulule isizwe kubuzwilakhe, esenza imimangaliso eyayichasene nayo yonke imithetho yendalo. Ukususela entabeni engcwele ukuya kummangaliso phezu kwamanzi, lo mkhonzi ka-Allah wabona imiqondiso eyayiza kuvakala kwixesha elide. Umsebenzi wakho namhlanje kukuchonga lo mntu umangalisayo onelifa elakha imbali yoluntu.
clues: Ndazalwa ngexesha apho abantu bakowethu babejongene nomthetho obulalayo, kwaye usapho lwam lwandifaka emanzini ukuze ndisindise ubomi bam.
Ndafunyanwa ndaza ndakhulela kanye endlwini yomlawuli owayeyalele ukuba kubulawe abantu bohlobo lwam.
Ndabalekela entabeni engcwele apho ndabona khona umlilo phezu komthi ongatshiyo, kwaye ilizwi lathetha nam lisuka kuyo.
Ndathunyelwa kwakhona kuloo mlawuli ngemimangaliso, ndifuna inkululeko yabantu bam abakhotyokisiweyo.
Ndalubetha ulwandle ngentonga yam, lwaqhekeka lwaba ziindlela ezomileyo, lwabaginya abo babelandela abantu bam.
Ndathetha neNkosi yam entabeni kangangeentsuku ezingamashumi amane, ndaza ndanikwa amacwecwe esikhokelo sikaThixo.
